name: trip
description: A trip in one place: the dates, what to pack, what to book.

use.when: the person is planning a journey or a stay away: they need the dates in view and two short lists that get shorter.
use.not: a single appointment, which is a calendar block, or a packing list on its own, which is a list.
use.with: the dates as event records, so bookings have their own pages.
